input.body:
Leonard,

The breakdown of the Unreconciled operating expenses line is done. The workbook is in the Q3 2025 investor reporting folder: "Q3 2025 card spend breakdown - Unreconciled operating expenses (Jan-Sep)". It has four tabs: By vendor, Category by month, Ledger tie-out and Q4 run-rate. Adding Robert as you asked, for the investor update.

Ledger tie-out: every month ties to the ledger to the cent. The Jan-Sep line comes to $97,968.21. Jan-May, Aug and Sep each match their own cycle. The July line ($24,354.37) is the June cycle ($12,222.02) plus the July cycle ($12,132.35). The only adjustment is $1,000.00 of Unity Ads in August, which is an ad network charge, so it is reclassed to marketing UA and not counted as opex.

Totals by Griffin category, Jan-Sep (non-payroll opex from the card line):
- Software & subscriptions: $8,361.12
- Hosting & infrastructure: $27,305.36 (includes Unity seats, $17,970.00, per Griffin's ruling)
- Research & user testing: $2,086.46
- Marketing (non-UA): $3,019.00 (GDC 2025 passes net of the $399 refund, per Griffin's ruling, plus Fiverr store screenshots and trailer)
- Travel & events: $23,043.63
- Hardware & equipment: $19,203.87
- Professional & admin: $7,473.00
- Other G&A: $6,475.77
Total: $96,968.21. Adding the $1,000.00 UA reclass gives back the $97,968.21 ledger total.

Q4 monthly run-rate (recurring plans in this line only, bank-rule vendors excluded): $3,226.80/month
- Hosting & infrastructure, $1,703.04: Unity Pro $850.00 (1/12 of the $10,200 annual prepay), Edgegap $420.00 (downgrade confirmed by Edgegap on Sep 29, starts with the Oct 10 invoice), Google Cloud $396.84, Webflow $29.00, Namecheap $7.20
- Software & subscriptions, $590.76: Sensor Tower $250.00 (Lite), Zapier $73.50, ChatGPT $60.00 (2 seats), Canva $45.00, DocuSign $45.00, Envato $27.04, 1Password $23.97 (3 seats from Oct), Murf $22.00, Buttondown $20.00, SavvyCal $16.00, Apple Developer $8.25
- Professional & admin, $634.00: Carta $230.00, Deel $147.00, Gusto $142.00, QuickBooks $90.00, Cogency $25.00
- Other G&A, $299.00: WeWork $299.00
These are at $0 after confirmed cancellations or downgrades: AppMagic, Notion, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Midjourney, Loom, Zoom, Supernormal and Backtrace.

Disputed charges (billed after a confirmed cancellation and not refunded by the Sep 28 sheet): $159.99 total
- LinkedIn Sales Navigator, $99.99, posted Sep 3 on card 0417. Cancelled Aug 21; LinkedIn's email said access ran to Sep 2 with no further charges.
- Midjourney, $60.00, posted Sep 2 on card 0417. Cancelled Jul 3. The Aug 2 charge was refunded on Aug 25, but the Sep 2 charge was not.

I put the cut list findings in a comment on the Q4 cost cuts card; I didn't touch the checklist. Arthur's items that are still being charged (Unity, Edgegap, 1Password, Google Cloud) are on ENG-2370.

Fred

final:
I've done everything Leonard's email asked for: the workbook is in the Q3 2025 investor reporting folder, and your reply is sent on his thread. Every month ties exactly to the ledger line.

**Workbook:** "Q3 2025 card spend breakdown – Unreconciled operating expenses (Jan-Sep)", with the four tabs his close notes specify (By vendor, Category by month, Ledger tie-out, Q4 run-rate). I built it from all 496 daily sheets in the card feed folder for both cards, including the 7 late-refund ("adjustments") tabs.

**Ledger tie-out:** The line totals $97,968.21 for January–September.
- The July ledger line ($24,354.37) covers both the June and July statement periods, as his notes describe.
- The one adjustment is $1,000 of Unity Ads in August. That's ad spend, so it's moved out of opex to marketing user acquisition.

**Totals by Griffin's categories:**

| Category | Jan–Sep |
|---|---|
| Software & subscriptions | $8,361.12 |
| Hosting & infrastructure | $27,305.36 |
| Research & user testing | $2,086.46 |
| Marketing (non-UA) | $3,019.00 |
| Travel & events | $23,043.63 |
| Hardware & equipment | $19,203.87 |
| Professional & admin | $7,473.00 |
| Other G&A | $6,475.77 |
| **Total** | **$96,968.21** |

- **Griffin's two open items:** he has since answered them (Leonard relayed this in Slack on Sep 30). The GDC conference passes go under Marketing, and Unity seats go under Hosting. Unity's $10,200 annual prepay in August is why Hosting jumps that month.
- **Fiverr:** the two orders were app store screenshots and a store trailer, so they're under Marketing.

**Q4 recurring spend:** $3,226.80 a month, broken down by vendor in the workbook. It reflects the confirmed changes: Edgegap drops to $420, Sensor Tower is on the $250 plan, ChatGPT is down to 2 seats, and 1Password to 3 seats. AppMagic, Notion, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Midjourney are cancelled, so they're at $0.

**Disputed charges ($159.99 total):**
- **LinkedIn Sales Navigator:** $99.99 charged Sep 3, after you cancelled on Aug 21. LinkedIn's confirmation email was sent to your inbox, so the dispute is likely yours to raise.
- **Midjourney:** $60 charged Sep 2. It was cancelled Jul 3, and the August charge was refunded but this one wasn't.

**Where else I posted:**
- **Email:** to Leonard, with Arthur and Robert cc'd. Leonard asked in Slack on Sep 30 to add Robert for the investor update.
- **Trello:** a comment with the findings on the "Q4 cost cuts – card subscriptions" card. I didn't touch the checklist and didn't create a new card.
- **Linear:** a comment on Arthur's seat cleanup ticket (ENG-2370) listing his subscriptions that are still being charged: Unity, Edgegap, 1Password and Google Cloud.

One judgment call: I used 3 seats for 1Password ($23.97 a month), based on Leonard's Sep 29 note on the 1Password Trello card. That replaces Arthur's earlier note of 4 seats.
